scope: Strict signed trend-forecast creation request and response contract
checks_cover: Strict allowlisted request and OpenAPI bounds for metric key, forecast horizon, and confidence values
Invalid request fields are rejected before the compute service and return no-store errors
Created forecasts return the existing 201 shape including forecast_at
Matching active forecasts return the existing 200 shape without forecast_at
Malformed service output and request-location/metric/horizon mismatches fail closed
Forecast computation continues to use signed location context and verified source metrics
rollback: Revert the forecast route models/validation, focused route tests, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
